about: The model of the harness's own helper calls outside the engine (run names now; summaries and labels later). It is not a coding model: it is never in engine/catalog/models.json and never a run choice. A row is selectable only with a passing smoke record, which has two halves: the S6 matrix (probes/smoke.py) and U1 (probes/utility_smoke.py, which checks a run name); the U1 record sits beside this file. The top-level record is the run-name record. Each other purpose has its own record in `purposes` (run-tags: U2, probes/utility_smoke.py --purpose run-tags, because the tag call has its own prompt), and a purpose is served only by a row that holds a record for it. `alias` is the short name that HAMH_UTILITY_MODEL accepts at deploy (or off), and the row that `default` names is what an unset setting means. Thinking is disabled because with the default thinking a 60-token cap came back empty in 19 of 24 odd-input calls. Edit by hand only to add a smoked row or route; the tests crates/ham-core/tests/utility_builtin.rs and scripts/tests/test_utility_catalog.py pin this file and its record.
